content_zh:
迎宾小姐嘴角抽搐了下，不敢相信自己的耳朵，以为自己听错了。
塌鼻梁男子急了，大喊道：“让你去叫魏总，赶快。”
“是，是。”
迎宾小姐吓得一哆嗦，瞥了眼陈阳，忙不迭地朝着楼上跑去，高跟鞋踩在地板上，静悄悄的大厅里回荡着蹬蹬蹬的声音。
在三十多名保安恶狠狠的目光下，陈阳依旧神态自若，自顾自的抽着烟，还不时吐出不同花样的烟圈。
很快，一大群人从楼梯跑了下来，不下五十人，加入到包围陈阳的人群之中。
紧接着，叮咚的电梯声音响起，一道愤怒的声音传来：“他娘的，竟然打扰我接待梁爷，老子一定要把你扔进河里喂鱼，不然梁爷还以为我没把临江区的黑狼帮人马管理好。”
人群散开一条道，一名穿着黑西装，脖子上挂着大金项链，身材肥胖的中年男子走了过来。
对方人多势众，杀气腾腾，此人这一登场，还颇有几分上位者的气势。
不过在陈阳的眼里，这气势根本就是个屁，也是气，但没有势。
“你是魏勇？”
陈阳坐在沙发上，抬了抬眼皮，淡定无比。
“小子，你闯进皇潮阁，打了我黑狼帮的人，竟然还敢这么嚣张，难道你真不知道死字怎么写？”魏勇冷笑了声，面色一沉道：“既然如此，那我就教教你怎么写‘死’字。来人，把他绑起来，今晚扔到河里喂鱼。”
得到魏勇的命令，黑狼帮的成员一个个杀气腾腾地朝陈阳扑了上去。
可接下来的一幕，彻底令黑狼帮的成员傻了眼，陈阳依旧坐在沙发上，嘴上抽着烟，连屁股都没挪动一下，只见其双腿如风，将所有靠近他的人都踢翻在地。
眼看自己这方瞬间躺下了十多人，黑狼帮的成员停下了扑向陈阳的脚步，不敢靠近，只觉背脊一阵发凉。
“魏勇，你就这样招待客人？”陈阳冷笑一声，抖了抖烟灰，眼神中充满了不屑。
“找死！”
魏勇看出陈阳是高手，冷喝一声，面露狰狞之色，伸手摸向腰间，想要掏抢。
在他看来，陈阳就算再厉害，也不可能挡得住子弹。

就在这时，魏勇身后一名头发灰白的国字脸男子按住了他的手，沉声道：“魏勇，住手。”
“梁爷。”魏勇回头看向国字脸男子，皱了下眉头，手缓缓地松开了手枪。
面对这位梁爷，魏勇不敢不尊敬，因为梁爷在黑狼帮的身份仅次于老大，而且因为某些特殊的原因，就连老大都要对他礼让三分。
梁爷往前走了几步，目光如鹰隼般盯着陈阳，拱了拱手，声如洪钟道：“鄙人河西八卦手梁威，请问小兄弟师承何人？”
陈阳上下打量着梁威，笑了笑：“想问我师承，你还未够资格。”
“小兄弟未免太托大了，难道不知山外有山，人外有人的道理吗？”
梁威面色一变，迈步朝陈阳走过来，身上的骨节啪啪炸响，整个人气势腾腾，隐隐有一种无形的气机将这片空间笼罩。
见陈阳还坐在沙发上不动，梁威心头大怒，脚下加速，猛然朝陈阳扑了上去，决定给这个不知天高地厚的年轻人一个教训。
他一拳轰出，空气噼啪炸响，拳速之快，威势之猛，令周围黑狼帮的成员都是心惊肉跳。
“不自量力。”
陈阳嘴角勾起一抹笑意，右手把烟头往嘴巴上送，左拳不疾不徐地朝着对方轰去。
一声巨响，声如雷霆，犹如两辆汽车相撞。
下一刻，梁威脸上露出惊惧之色，只觉一股巨力从陈阳的拳头上传来，紧接着他整个人便失去了控制，朝后飞出去，将身后的黑狼帮成员冲散，然后撞在前台，将大理石的前台整个撞得塌陷了下去，他这才停下去势。
一时间，整个皇潮阁大厅鸦雀无声，看着陈阳，所有人脑中都闪过一个问题，这是人吗？
“梁爷！”
魏勇第一个反应过来，急忙跑过去扶住梁威，心都提到了嗓子眼。
他知道梁威的底细，这可是老大帮了对方个大忙，好不容易才请来坐镇黑狼帮的高人，可是高人在陈阳面前，却完全没有招架之力。
“咳咳……”
梁威咳出一口鲜血，踉跄着站起来，面色凝重地看向陈阳，沉声道：“你到底是谁？”
陈阳把手中的烟蒂在茶几上按灭，抬头道：“看你出手的架势，应该是河西梁家的嫡传，我记得梁家有个叫梁成虎的，和你是什么关系？”

content_en:
The corner of the welcoming lady's mouth twitched. She couldn't believe her ears and thought she heard wrongly.
The man with the flat nose became anxious and shouted: "I want you to call Mr. Wei, hurry up."
"Yes, yes."
The welcoming lady trembled with fright, glanced at Chen Yang, and hurriedly ran upstairs, her high heels hitting the floor, and the sound of stepping echoed in the quiet hall.
Under the fierce gazes of more than 30 security guards, Chen Yang remained calm and self-sufficient, smoking a cigarette and blowing out different smoke rings from time to time.
Soon, a large group of people ran down the stairs, no less than fifty people, joining the crowd surrounding Chen Yang.
Immediately afterwards, the ding-dong sound of the elevator sounded, and an angry voice came: "Damn it, you actually disturbed my reception of Master Liang. I must throw you into the river to feed the fish, otherwise Master Liang will think that I have not managed the Black Wolf Gang in Linjiang District well."
The crowd dispersed, and a fat middle-aged man in a black suit with a large gold chain hanging around his neck walked over.
The opponent has a large number of people and is full of murderous intent. This person's appearance has quite a bit of the aura of a superior person.
However, in Chen Yang's eyes, this momentum is nothing but nonsense. It is also gas, but without momentum.
"Are you Wei Yong?"
Chen Yang sat on the sofa, raised his eyelids, and was extremely calm.
"Boy, you broke into Huangchao Pavilion and beat up a member of my Black Wolf Gang, but you still dare to be so arrogant. Do you really not know how to write the word "death"?" Wei Yong sneered, and his face darkened: "In that case, I will teach you how to write the word 'death'. Someone, tie him up and throw him into the river to feed the fish tonight."
After receiving Wei Yong's order, the members of the Black Wolf Gang rushed towards Chen Yang with murderous intent.
But the next scene completely stunned the members of the Black Wolf Gang. Chen Yang was still sitting on the sofa, smoking a cigarette, without even moving his buttocks. His legs were like the wind, kicking everyone who was close to him to the ground.
Seeing that more than ten people were lying down on their side in an instant, the members of the Black Wolf Gang stopped rushing toward Chen Yang and did not dare to get close. They only felt a chill down their spines.
"Wei Yong, are you entertaining guests like this?" Chen Yang sneered, shaking the ashes from his cigarette, his eyes full of disdain.
"Seeking death!"
Wei Yong saw that Chen Yang was a master, so he shouted coldly, with a ferocious look on his face, and reached for his waist, trying to grab it.
In his opinion, no matter how powerful Chen Yang is, he can't stop a bullet.
At this moment, a gray-haired man with Chinese characters behind Wei Yong held his hand and said in a deep voice: "Wei Yong, stop."
"Master Liang." Wei Yong looked back at the man with the Chinese character face, frowned, and slowly released his hand from the pistol.
Facing Mr. Liang, Wei Yong did not dare to be disrespectful, because Mr. Liang's status in the Black Wolf Gang was second only to the boss, and for some special reasons, even the boss had to show courtesy to him.
Mr. Liang took a few steps forward and stared at Chen Yang like a hawk. He cupped his hands and said in a voice like a bell: "I, Liang Wei, a gossip master in Hexi, may I ask who your apprentice is?"
Chen Yang looked Liang Wei up and down and smiled: "You want to ask about my apprenticeship, but you are not qualified yet."
"Little brother, you are too trusting. Don't you know that there are mountains outside the mountains and there are people outside the people?"
Liang Wei's expression changed, and he walked towards Chen Yang. The joints on his body crackled, and his whole body was full of energy. There was an invisible energy that enveloped the space.
Seeing that Chen Yang was still sitting on the sofa, Liang Wei was furious, sped up his feet, and suddenly rushed towards Chen Yang, deciding to teach this young man who didn't know the heights of the world a lesson.
He punched out, and the air crackled and exploded. The speed and power of the punch made the surrounding members of the Black Wolf Gang tremble with fear.
“Don’t overestimate your own capabilities.”
A smile appeared at the corner of Chen Yang's mouth, he put the cigarette butt to his mouth with his right hand, and hit the opponent with his left fist unhurriedly.
A loud noise, as loud as thunderTing is like two cars colliding.
The next moment, Liang Wei's face showed a look of fear, and he felt a huge force coming from Chen Yang's fist. Then he lost control and flew backwards, scattering the Black Wolf Gang members behind him, and then hit the front desk, causing the entire marble front desk to collapse. Only then did he stop castrating.
For a moment, the entire Huangchao Pavilion hall was silent. Looking at Chen Yang, a question flashed in everyone's mind, is this a human?
"Master Liang!"
Wei Yong was the first to react and hurried over to support Liang Wei, his heart in his throat.
He knew the details of Liang Wei, and the boss had done him a big favor. He finally invited the master who was in charge of the Black Wolf Gang, but the master was completely powerless in front of Chen Yang.
"Ahem..."
Liang Wei coughed up a mouthful of blood, staggered to his feet, looked at Chen Yang solemnly, and said in a deep voice: "Who are you?"
Chen Yang put out the cigarette butt in his hand on the coffee table, raised his head and said, "Looking at the way you struck, you should be a direct descendant of the Liang family in Hexi. I remember that there is a man named Liang Chenghu in the Liang family. What is your relationship with him?"
